## What changed

A short description of the change and the problem it solves.

## Contract impact

Does this change a public operation, a carrier, a validation rule, freshness
behavior, or a documented contract? If yes, link the updated document.

## Tests

- [ ] Added or updated tests
- [ ] Ran `pytest`
- [ ] Ran the installed-MCP lane if the transport or installer changed

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] The change is scoped to one behavior or contract
- [ ] Public docs are updated where the contract changed
- [ ] No secrets, absolute workspace paths, or proprietary fixtures were added
